ISimBrokerAccountCheckpoint.description: The account journal and all non-derived broker state commit together.

ISimBrokerCheckpoint.description: Complete broker state captured only between causal market slices.

positionUnrealizedPnl.description: Broker-authoritative aggregate unrealized position PnL in account currency.

dailyPnl.description: Account-wide Daily PnL and its coverage, owned exclusively by the live broker adapter.

cancelableOrderIds.description: Pending Gu order ids whose current broker session exposes a complete cancellation handle.

unattributedPendingOrders.description: Active broker orders that cannot be attributed to a current Gu order.

unattributedPendingOrderSymbols.description: Symbols with active broker orders that cannot be attributed to a current Gu order.

entryBlockedSymbols.description: Symbols whose broker exposure is known but whose exact execution contract is temporarily unresolved.

openingEquity.description: Broker baseline, or broker equity less native PnL when no baseline is exposed.

history.description: Available chronological broker points; missing history never invalidates the current scalar.

IBrokerAccountPnl.description: Native account result with an optional broker-observed path for daily risk extrema.

ILiveAccountPnlPoint.description: One broker-sourced point on the same account-wide daily trading path.

openedAt.description: Proven start of current net exposure; unavailable when execution coverage is insufficient.

netSize.description: Signed broker net quantity: positive long, negative short.

IBrokerPositionSnapshot.description: Validated broker-authoritative net position for one execution symbol.

id.description: Stable account-scoped opaque identity safe for owner controls.

brokerOrderId.description: Stable provider identity when the broker has acknowledged one.

cancelable.description: Whether the current broker session exposes every identity required to cancel this order.

IBrokerPendingOrderSnapshot.description: Active broker order that cannot be coherently attributed to one current Gu order.

id.description: Internal order id. Always present and unique inside the account.

signalId.description: Internal unique id of the signal (for logging and correlation)

brokerOrderId.description: Broker order id as returned by the broker. May be undefined for backtests or before acceptance.

observedBrokerOrderId.description: Retained remote broker evidence on immutable legacy broker-truth journal rows.

positionId.description: Associated position id. This value is assigned when the order is created and never changes afterwards.

tradeSymbol.description: Tradable symbol to send to the broker

intent.description: Order intent: open a new position or close an existing one

size.description: Order size in units (shares, contracts, etc.). This is the requested size by Gu, not necessarily filled yet.

emitPrice.description: Price snapshot when the order was created, this is used for logging and backtesting

stopPrice.description: Stop price for stop and stop-limit orders

takeProfit.description: Logical take profit level suggested by the strategy. This is a *position-level* target, not necessarily a broker order.

stopLoss.description: Logical stop loss level suggested by the strategy. This is a *position-level* protection, not necessarily a broker order.

status.description: Current order status - DO NOT CHANGE DIRECTLY

timeInForce.description: Broker lifecycle policy for this order

extendedHours.description: Submit this order during the broker's supported extended-hours session.

oco.description: One-cancels-others flag.  Are all orders in the group to be canceled when one is filled?

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the order was created (epoch UTC)

createdSequence.description: Account-local causal sequence assigned when the order was created

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the order was last updated (epoch UTC)

statusReason.description: Exact broker-authored terminal reason for a rejected or canceled order

fills.description: All fills associated with this order. Empty or undefined means no fills yet.

filledSize.description: Total filled size (sum of all fills.size). 0 when no fills, equals "size" when fully filled.

avgFillPrice.description: Average fill price. Undefined if there are no fills yet.

totalFees.description: Total fees paid for this order (sum of fills.fees). Undefined if not available or not filled.

score.description: A custom score assigned to this order by the Risk Manager.

meta.description: Additional information for debugging or analytics

riskMeta.description: Optional risk metadata extracted from the originating signal

IOrder.description: Concrete order object created from an execute/stop signal and sent to a broker or simulated in backtests.

OrderSide.description: Logical side of the trade from the strategy viewpoint. How this maps to BUY/SELL depends on the instrument type. IMPORTANT: do NOT change these values as they are used in calculations!

value.description: Non-negative magnitude. With type "perc", this is a ratio from 0 to 1 resolved against the basis documented by the owning parameter; otherwise it uses that parameter's fixed unit.

type.description: Value interpretation: "fixed" uses the owning parameter's unit and "perc" uses its documented basis. Defaults to "fixed".

OrderStatus.description: Order status (not broker-native, this is normalized).

OrderTimeInForce.description: Time-in-force abstraction. Not all brokers will support all values.

price.description: Fill price for this individual fill

size.description: Filled size for this individual fill

time.description: Time when this fill occurred (epoch UTC)

sequence.description: Monotonic account-local sequence used to order trading events sharing one timestamp

localPrice.description: Fill price converted to local account currency (price * exchange rate)

fxRate.description: Exact broker-owned conversion rate applied to this fill.

fxObservationFingerprint.description: Frozen observation identity proving the conversion used by this fill.

fees.description: Fees paid for this specific fill in local account currency

spread.description: Spread cost paid for this specific fill in local account currency

slippage.description: Slippage cost paid for this specific fill in local account currency

allocatedCapital.description: Effective capital allocated by this fill in account currency. For cash instruments this is typically cash plus fees. For margined instruments this is typically initial margin plus fees.

IOrderFillMeta.description: Single fill event for an order. An order can be filled in multiple chunks.

ISignalRiskMeta.description: Optional risk metadata attached to signals and orders

sourceIds.description: Source row identifiers collapsed into this economic event.

providerSymbol.description: Exact provider ticker retained separately from the immutable instrument ID.

market.description: Frozen market session used to derive the causal barrier timestamp.

sessionProfileId.description: Frozen instrument-session profile owning the action date boundary.

effectiveAt.description: First instant at which the action is observable by the engine.

executionDate.description: Canonical exchange-local execution date in YYYY-MM-DD form.

quantityScale.description: Raw shares after the event divided by raw shares before the event.

IAppliedStockSplitCorporateAction.description: Applied stock split persisted after the same causal barrier as its portfolio mutations.

sourceIds.description: Source row identifiers collapsed into this economic event.

providerSymbol.description: Exact provider ticker retained separately from the immutable instrument ID.

market.description: Frozen market session used to derive the causal barrier timestamp.

sessionProfileId.description: Frozen instrument-session profile owning the action date boundary.

effectiveAt.description: First instant at which the action is observable by the engine.

executionDate.description: Canonical exchange-local execution date in YYYY-MM-DD form.

recordDate.description: Record date used by the issuer to determine distribution entitlement.

entitlementPolicy.description: Regular-way shares carry their due-bill entitlement through the ex-distribution barrier.

childSymbol.description: Canonical child security distributed by the parent issuer.

childSharesPerParent.description: Child shares distributed for each pre-event parent share.

parentPriceScale.description: Scale mapping pre-event parent prices onto the post-event raw price domain.

basisAllocationPolicy.description: Causal policy used to allocate parent basis once real joint opening marks are observable.

fractionalSharePolicy.description: Deterministic treatment required when the distribution produces child fractions.

parentCostBasisFactor.description: Frozen causal factor retaining aggregate pre-event basis on the parent security.

childCostBasisFactor.description: Frozen causal factor transferring aggregate pre-event basis to the child security.

parentValuationPrice.description: Parent execution price observed at the joint regular-opening valuation barrier.

childValuationPrice.description: Child execution price observed at the same joint regular-opening valuation barrier.

IAppliedSpinOffCorporateAction.description: Applied spin-off persisted after the same causal barrier as its portfolio mutations.

id.description: Stable identity derived from the action and entitlement side.

actionId.description: Corporate action that created this settlement bucket.

childPositionId.description: Deterministic physical position identity reserved for whole child shares.

strategyId.description: Engine-reserved identity of the pooled physical position.

currency.description: Child instrument and account currencies respectively.

side.description: Entitlement side shared by the bucket and all of its allocations.

signedWholeChildSize.description: Signed whole child shares delivered to the physical child position.

signedFractionalCashInLieuSize.description: Signed aggregate fractional child entitlement settled in cash.

childAvgPrice.description: Pooled raw and account-currency basis of the physical child position.

cashInLieuPrice.description: Raw and account-currency barrier prices used for fractional settlement.

cashAdjustment.description: Rounded account-currency totals produced by fractional settlement.

allocations.description: Source-lineage allocations ordered by physical source and immediate allocation identity.

appliedAt.description: Causal barrier at which the entitlement was applied.

appliedSequence.description: Account-local causal sequence of the application barrier.

ICorporateActionDistribution.description: Immutable account-level settlement bucket created by one spin-off and one side. A non-zero whole entitlement seeds one pooled physical child position, while allocations preserve logical strategy lineages and fractional settlement.

id.description: Stable identity derived from the action and immediate source identities.

sourcePositionId.description: Position whose shares created this entitlement.

sourceAllocationId.description: Immediate beneficial allocation inside a pooled source, or null for a strategy-owned source.

rootPositionId.description: First strategy-created position in this entitlement lineage.

strategyId.description: Strategy that owns the logical source lineage.

signedChildAllocationSize.description: Signed beneficial share of the pooled whole-child position.

signedFractionalCashInLieuSize.description: Signed fractional entitlement settled as cash-in-lieu.

childAvgPrice.description: Child basis transferred from this source lineage in child and account currencies.

cashAdjustment.description: Rounded account-currency cash and realized PnL attributed to this lineage.

ICorporateActionDistributionAllocation.description: Immutable attribution of one source lineage to a pooled spin-off settlement bucket.

ISimBrokerExecutionCheckpoint.description: Trigger and residual-liquidity state must survive process boundaries without a second fill.

priceScale.description: Multiplier applied to raw prices and price distances.

priceOffset.description: Additive adjustment applied only to absolute prices.

quantityScale.description: Multiplier that converts reference quantities into raw quantities.

IPriceTransform.description: Affine mapping between execution/raw units and the causal reference units observed by a strategy at one market timestamp.

IQuoteLiquidityBar.description: Causal NBBO liquidity state aligned to one completed market bar.
